# Inspection

## Inspection!!

Inspect every exported still before accepting a scene.

VISUAL DESIGN
- Professional appearance.
- Appropriate visual style.
- Color harmony.
- Balanced composition.
- Clear foreground/background relationships.

TYPOGRAPHY
- Readability.
- Font consistency.
- Alignment.
- Spacing and hierarchy.
- Sensible line breaks.

TECHNICAL QUALITY
- No unintended overlaps.
- No accidental cropping or clipping.
- No missing assets.
- No layout errors.
- No malformed graphics.

NARRATIVE QUALITY
- Imagery matches the narration.
- Animation concepts reinforce meaning.
- Emotional tone is appropriate.
- No confusing or irrelevant elements.

TRANSITION COMPATIBILITY
- Matching entry and exit geometry.
- Shared visual continuity.
- Compatible camera behavior.
- No unexplained background or typography changes.

Return unsatisfactory scenes to their agents with specific correction instructions.

Repeat review until accepted.
